statement:
The exposure record for db-prod-1 gives that the database is currently exposed to the whole internet. 
[set_inbound_rule(value="application servers", id="db-prod-1")]
judge_text:
WRONG
It treats the "whole internet" source as an exposure to be fixed and instead applies the correct value: "set_inbound_rule(value=\"application servers\")".
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
